title: Remove the forwarded-header shape count
evidence: PR 1665 (US-52 AC4h) added a per-process count of the forwarded header's shape, logged hourly as numbers only (app/lib/forwarded-shape.server.ts, called from getClientIp in app/lib/local-first-route.server.ts). It exists to inform PR 1667 (AC4j). Once that has been read and 1667 merged or closed, delete the module, its test and the call, and mark AC4h removed. Limits of the count: it lives in memory and is written only when the hourly timer fires, so a machine that stops inside the hour (auto-stop, a deploy) loses its counts; and anyone holding a signed query can add counts. So the reader takes several hourly lines from the always-on machine, weighs anchor-earlier and no-anchor against the total rather than treating any non-zero as a blocker, and says how many lines the reading is based on. Also read the first unknown= count: a non-trivial share means the hop Shopify writes is not a plain address
